Dear Dr. Linda Myers,

I am writing to request a medication evaluation appointment to assess the effectiveness of my current medication regimen, particularly in light of my recent experiences with elevated cortisol levels, moderate to severe grief, and anxiety. As you are aware, I have been dealing with the aftermath of a miscarriage, a pending legal case, and the financial implications of a bankruptcy filing.

I would like to schedule an appointment to discuss my current mental health status, including my PHQ-9 depression score of 18 and anxiety score of 12. I have been coping with my emotions through mindfulness meditation, journaling, and attending therapy sessions. However, I believe it would be beneficial to evaluate my medication regimen to ensure it is optimally supporting my mental health.

Could we schedule an appointment at your earliest convenience? I am available to meet on weekdays and would appreciate your guidance on any necessary preparations or information to bring to the appointment.

Thank you for your time and support.

Sincerely,
Andrew Cross
